fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6TBD; there was no owner. The planner read internal/session/names.go and its callers in internal/api (session.go, run.go, run_leaves.go, run_checks.go, ship.go, ship_openpr.go), where each one re-derives the branch and worktree from session.Slug(title). It asked one question, how to make slugs unique. The arbiter answered with Decision slug-unique-by-earliest-id: a change set whose title slug matches an earlier change set's (lower ID, any state) gets a suffix of the first 12 characters of its ID, lowercased, and one function over the model gives the slug to every caller. The planner settled the PR guard itself: ship tracks only a pull request whose body names this change set, using the 'Change set <id>' line that open-pr already writes, and refuses any other. The change set serves m29-one-daemon, as the sibling governor fixes do.
fields.title: Unique change set slugs, autonomous plan

fields.acceptance: A testscript opens worktrees for two change sets with the same title and gets two distinct branches cs/<slug> and cs/<slug>-<first 12 characters of the later change set's ID, lowercased> (never its display short ID) and two distinct worktrees; internal/api tests show the ship target and abandon cleanup of the later change set name its suffixed branch; no call to session.Slug(title) remains outside the slug function
fields.statement: Every place that names a change set's branch or worktree (change worktree, run start and dry run, run leaves and checks sessions, ship target, abandon cleanup) uses the unique slug, never session.Slug(title) directly
